verdict.rationale: Shortwave's first-party Splits feature divides one inbox into multiple focused, tabbed inboxes. Splits can be defined by importance, built-in or custom labels, specific senders, or complex search queries, and the docs frame them as a way to handle different email types at different times, i.e. triage by priority. missing for 10: explicit documentation of newsletter and calendar-invite splits (only implied via labels/search queries), and independent hands-on corroboration of Splits specifically (community praise covers Bundles grouping, a different feature).

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order

citations.quote: They’re a simple way to divide your one big inbox into multiple smaller, more focused inboxes – each in its own tab.
Splits let you handle different types of emails at different times, so you can stay responsive where it matters most.
You can define Splits based on: Importance, Built-in labels... Custom labels, Specific senders, Complex search queries
